fusions.name: Ley-Root Lance
fusions.desc: Draws raw arcana up through your roots and fires it as a lance that deals 30 damage, ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Glittering Pollen
fusions.desc: Breathes a cone of charged pollen, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Through the Xylem
fusions.desc: Draws mana up through your wood: you regain 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Bark Takes the Charge
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, the spillover hardens your bark into a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
